user.title: Connect Apple Push
user.description: Create an APNs key in your Apple Developer account (Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles → Keys, with Apple Push Notifications enabled), then paste the whole .p8 file here. The key is checked with Apple before it is saved.

data_description.key: Everything from -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY----- to -----END PRIVATE KEY-----.
data_description.key_id: The 10-character ID shown next to the key.
data_description.team_id: The 10-character ID in the top right of your developer account.
data_description.bundle_id: Leave as com.sfenton.home unless the app's bundle ID changes.

error.invalid_key: That isn't an APNs key. Paste the full contents of the .p8 file.
error.key_rejected: Apple rejected the key. Check the Key ID and Team ID, and that the key has Apple Push Notifications enabled.
error.bundle_rejected: Apple accepted the key but not for this bundle ID. Check that push is enabled for the app ID.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Apple's push service. Check Home Assistant's internet connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: Push is already set up for this app.

data.person_notify: Notify action for people without S+H

data_description.critical_alerts: Turn on only after Apple grants the app the Critical Alerts entitlement. Until then, critical notifications arrive as time-sensitive.
data_description.push_base_url: Where Home Assistant can reach itself, such as http://127.0.0.1:8123. Leave empty to use the internal URL. The app picks up a change the next time it opens.
data_description.live_jobs_enabled: Turn off to stop all Live Activity cards. Problems then go to everyone as ordinary notifications.
data_description.live_jobs: Each job runs as its own Live Activity.
data_description.live_devices: Leave empty for every device with Live Activities allowed.
data_description.person_notify: The notify action that reaches a person's whole phone. Use * for their first name: *_s_phone is notify.stephen_s_phone for Stephen.

problem.name: Raise a device problem
problem.description: Shows a problem card on the Live Activities of people who have the app and sends the ordinary notification to everyone else.

device.name: Device
device.description: The device with the problem, such as main_floor, music_room, theater_room or dishwasher.

code.name: Code
code.description: The problem code, such as navigation.stuck. Leave empty to work it out from the raw text.

raw.name: Raw error text
raw.description: The robot's own error text, for unknown and unmapped errors.

title.name: Notification title
title.description: The title of the ordinary notification.

message.name: Notification message
message.description: The text of the ordinary notification.

task_title.name: Donetick task title
task_title.description: The Donetick task the card follows. Leave empty when there is no task.

url.name: Link
url.description: Where a tap on the notification goes.

tag.name: Notification tag
tag.description: The tag of the ordinary notification, cleared when the card ends.

data.name: Extra notification data
data.description: More data for the ordinary notification.
